newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV authorises Glencore Asturiana offer.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV authorises Glencore Asturiana offer.

text.p: Spanish Stock Market Commission CNMV said on Tuesday its board has authorised Glencore Investment B.V.'s offer to buy 20 percent of the shares of Asturiana de Zinc.
The offer is for a maximum of 8,065,190 shares for a nominal value of 525 pesetas a share.
The price offered is 3,400 pesetas a share, backed by a guarantee of 27.42 billion pesetas from Morgan Trust Guaranty Trust Co.
Shares will be accepted for one month from a start date to be announced in the future.
The operation, together with holdings, will bring Glencore's stake to 44.80 percent in Asturiana.
